data: Does the performance of the RLM model improve with increasing training data?

The graph shows two lines representing the RLM and RPE models' performance in terms of F1-measure against the number of training queries (in millions). The RLM line is consistently above the RPE line across all query counts, indicating better performance for RLM. Both lines show an upward trend, suggesting improvement with more training data. Therefore, the performance of the RLM model improves with increasing training data.
